shortDescription: AirAsia Group Bhd. founder Tony Fernandes said he is fed up with private credit and the high interest rates it charges, according to Bloomberg. The comments come as oil trades near $100.

title: AirAsia Seeks Cheaper Debt as Oil Nears $100
